name: Peregrine Mission 1
summary: First CLPS flight. Suffered propulsion valve failure shortly after trans-lunar injection. Returned cislunar space science data (LETS and NSS) before controlled Earth atmospheric re-entry on Jan 18, 2024.
scientificObjectives: Investigate lunar volatiles, radiation environment, and exosphere at Sinus Viscositatis.

name: IM-1 (Odysseus)

coordinates.targetDescription: Crater rim in South Pole highlands, -3,607m elevation

summary: Historic mission: first commercial spacecraft to soft land on the Moon and first US lunar landing since Apollo 17 (1972). NASA's NDL payload was patched real-time to save descent navigation. Touched down with lateral velocity causing a tilted rest position, but all active payloads operated and transmitted scientific data.
scientificObjectives: Plume-surface interactions, radio astronomy, radio-frequency mass gauging, and autonomous positioning beacons near South Pole.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 1

coordinates.targetDescription: Basaltic mare plain on eastern nearside

summary: Carried the largest single scientific payload suite in CLPS history (10 instruments). Conducted comprehensive studies of lunar regolith, mantle heat flow, Earth magnetosphere soft X-ray imaging, and dust mitigation.
scientificObjectives: Probe interior heat flow, regolith adherence, global GNSS navigation, and space weather interactions.

name: Griffin Mission 1

coordinates.targetDescription: Flat-topped mountain plateau near Nobile Crater

summary: Originally manifested for NASA's VIPER rover. Following VIPER cancellation in July 2024 to protect program budget, NASA maintained the contract as a Griffin lander flight qualification test carrying a rover mass simulator and flight instrument package.
scientificObjectives: Heavy-class commercial lander descent demonstration and polar terrain touchdown characterization.

name: IM-2 (PRIME-1)

coordinates.targetDescription: Ultra-high latitude polar ridge bordering Shackleton Crater

summary: First direct in-situ subsurface volatile drilling mission on the Moon. TRIDENT will drill 1 meter deep in 10-cm increments, feeding cuttings to the MSolo mass spectrometer to detect water ice and volatile species before solar sublimation.
scientificObjectives: Direct volatile prospecting, subsurface temperature profiling, and polar ice characterization.

name: IM-3 (Rayyan)

coordinates.targetDescription: Oceanus Procellarum lunar swirl and magnetic anomaly

summary: Exploration of the famous Reiner Gamma lunar swirl. Investigates localized crustal magnetic fields and solar wind shielding. Features NASA JPL's CADRE autonomous multi-rover cooperative swarm demonstration.
scientificObjectives: Origin of lunar swirls, crustal magnetism, and autonomous multi-agent cooperative surface robotics.

name: Team Draper APEX 1.0

coordinates.targetDescription: Multi-ring pristine impact basin inside South Pole-Aitken

summary: First far-side seismic investigation. FSS features insulated vacuum-vault seismometers designed to survive the 14-day freezing lunar night to record deep moonquakes and meteorite impact rates.
scientificObjectives: Far-side deep interior geophysics, crustal thickness, and lunar night survival.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 2

coordinates.targetDescription: Radio-quiet lunar far side hemisphere and lunar orbit

summary: Carries DOE/NASA LuSEE-Night radio telescope to the radio-quiet far side to probe the 21-cm Dark Ages signal of the early universe. Deploys ESA's Lunar Pathfinder communications relay satellite into lunar orbit.
scientificObjectives: Cosmological Dark Ages radio astronomy, far-side orbital communication relay.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 3
summary: Exploration of the Gruithuisen Domes silicic volcanic province using lander and rover instruments to resolve how silica-rich magma formed on the Moon without water or plate tectonics.
scientificObjectives: Silicic volcanic petrogenesis and high-silica mineralogy.

name: IM-4 (Mons Mouton)
summary: PRISM-2 payload delivery to Mons Mouton investigating volatiles, local geology, and space weathering processes.
scientificObjectives: South polar volatile distribution and regional geochemical characterization.

name: Blue Moon MK1
summary: Heavy commercial cargo lander test capable of delivering up to 3 metric tons to the lunar surface. Demonstrates cryogenic fluid management (liquid hydrogen/liquid oxygen) and precision landing.
scientificObjectives: Cryogenic propellant storage in deep space, high-mass landing systems validation.

name: Blue Ghost Mission 4
summary: Science Mission Directorate polar surface delivery.
scientificObjectives: South Pole plasma environment, dust dynamics, and mineralogy.

name: Intuitive Machines Nova-D
summary: Delivery utilizing Intuitive Machines' enlarged Nova-D multi-engine lander to transport technology demonstrators and surface infrastructure.
scientificObjectives: Medium-class surface logistics and infrastructure deployment.
